decisions: The brief fits the bounded format: 45 seconds, 1920×1080 at 30 fps, silent local-review output, exactly five scenes, four supplied coordinator screenshots used once in the required order, and a final Kujo bumper. It requires screenshot-led visuals from the opening hook onward, prohibits captions, labels, standalone title cards, invented metrics, unsupported automation claims, and publication, while reserving narration attachment and timing verification for the coordinator.
stopCondition: Required artifact or review capability missing
